name: Benzyl Alcohol 0.9%
storage: Store at 2-8 °C, protected from light; do not freeze.
definition: Benzyl Alcohol 0.9% (BZA) is a laboratory solvent supplied as sterile solution. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 3 ml, 5 ml, 10 ml. Grade and composition are stated on the lot-specific certificate of analysis. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the sterile solution at 2-8 °C, protected from light. Documentation includes a lot-specific certificate of analysis. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: What documentation is supplied with Benzyl Alcohol 0.9%?
faq.answer: Every batch of Benzyl Alcohol 0.9% is released against a lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA) that records the product identity, grade, appearance and the batch number. The COA for the lot you receive is available on request.

faq.question: How should Benzyl Alcohol 0.9% be stored?
faq.answer: Store the BZA solution at 2–8 °C, protected from light, and do not freeze. Handling notes for each lot are printed on the certificate of analysis.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Benzyl Alcohol 0.9%?
faq.answer: Benzyl Alcohol 0.9% is stocked in 3 pack sizes (3 mL, 5 mL, 10 mL), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $12.00; 10–49 kits falls to $11.04 (−8%) and 50+ to $10.20 (−15%).
